question: Refer to the exhibit. A network engineer must monitor the traffic from the server on VLAN 80. All source traffic from the server must be captured on the monitoring device. Which configuration set meets these requirements?
context:
Topology: server on vlan70 and server on vlan90 connect through a switch (Eth1/2 to vlan80 server, Eth1/1 to Traffic Analyzer).
switch(config)# interface ethernet 1/1
switch(config-if)# switchport monitor
switch(config-if)# exit
switch(config)# monitor session 1
switch(config-monitor)# no shut
imageNote: Diagram: a switch has servers on vlan70 (top) and vlan90 (bottom), a server on vlan80 via Eth1/2, and a Traffic Analyzer connected via Eth1/1.
options:

switch(config-monitor)# source vlan 80

switch(config-monitor)# destination interface ethernet 1/1
switch(config-monitor)# filter vlan 80
